source_issue.title: Use Cypress to determine code coverage

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on enhancing the Volto project by integrating Cypress to measure code coverage. Code coverage helps us understand which parts of our code are being tested, ensuring better quality and fewer bugs.

## What needs to be done
We need to implement Cypress tests that can report code coverage. There's an existing solution from one of our contributors, so your job will be to help finalize and integrate this into the project.

## Helpful background
Cypress is a testing framework popular for end-to-end testing. Code coverage measures how much of your source code is covered by tests, which is crucial for maintaining high-quality software. For detailed information on Cypress and code coverage, check [here](https://docs.cypress.io/guides/tooling/code-coverage.html#E2E-code-coverage).

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with Cypress by reviewing its [documentation](https://docs.cypress.io/).
2. Check the discussions in this issue for any updates or solutions proposed by others—especially look for contributions by @valentinab25.
3. If you're new, make sure to read the [First-time contributors](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/first-time.html) guide, which outlines useful tips and things to avoid. 
4. Consider reaching out in the comments if you have questions or need clarification. Happy contributing!
